tagline.en_US: Self-hosted recipe manager for collecting, organizing, and sharing recipes.

description.en_US: CookTrace is a self-hosted recipe, pantry, and cooking management tool. It lets you organize recipes with custom collections, live ingredient scaling, and nutrition facts, while keeping inventory in a pantry tracker with expiration dates and barcode scanning. It also includes meal planning, automatic shopping list generation, and a cook mode with timers.
